gaps.what: carved sandstone claw pieces and scrolls along the neck sides, a moulded neck cap.
a timber hoist beam projecting from the top of the neck.
a row of three small-paned windows across the gable base, stepped up toward the centre.
a sand-painted timber pilaster frame with a cornice over the ground storey, a tall shop window, shop door and a separate house door.

notes: Steep upward view; the three-window row sits in the gable base between the claw pieces, so it is read as the gable attic.
